scientific_integrity: Analytic proofs are given in RESULT.md. The bundled exact checker tests formulas and finite cases without substituting for the universal proof. Independently conducted validation has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: For binomial trial counts of at least three, the general existence theorem excludes an unspecified interval of small success probabilities, not every success probability.
The full success-probability phase diagram is derived only for two sampled Binomial(3,p) counts.
Potential equivalent statements in unindexed older reliability or total-positivity work cannot be excluded.
title: A sharp real-rootedness boundary for maxima of binomial counts
